exposure: Intrathecal dexmedetomidine (2.5 mug) with hyperbaric bupivacaine
Intrathecal dexmedetomidine (5 mug) with hyperbaric bupivacaine
cohort: The study included patients undergoing Caesarean delivery under spinal anaesthesia.
finding: Intrathecal dexmedetomidine (5 mug) significantly reduced the incidence and intensity of shivering during Caesarean delivery under spinal anaesthesia compared to placebo and the 2.5 mug dose.
mod_finding: Intrathecal dexmedetomidine (5 mug) significantly reduced the incidence and intensity of shivering experienced by parturients undergoing lower segment Caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia.
